master: Use case: product-mockup. Create an exceptionally refined photorealistic luxury home-fragrance campaign still life, square high resolution. Fictional brand SEREIN. A substantial thick-walled deep amber glass candle with ivory cotton-paper label reading precisely 'SEREIN' and below 'FIG & CEDAR', dark bronze lid leaning nearby, and tall ivory textured rigid packaging box subtly debossed SEREIN. Candle unlit, beautiful wax visible. Small matching amber glass reed diffuser with a few elegant dark reeds behind the candle. Composition: product group in lower LEFT half, candle centered x30% y72%, box behind at x18% y58%, reeds up to y35%. All products fully inside image, no cropping. Environment: sculptural pale limestone shelf across lower fifth, softly folded natural linen lower right, softly sunlit warm plaster wall, deep walnut architectural recess on right, long gentle afternoon shadows. Upper right two thirds uncluttered negative space, will carry native ecommerce UI later. Authentic luxury editorial photography, real material imperfections, crisp elegant glass refractions, tactile paper, restrained warm highlights, rich brown not orange, no CGI/plastic/AI gloss. 85mm lens, sophisticated tonal depth. NO UI, no screens, no floating cards, no other text, no plants, no socks.
